verdicts.reason: A breaks the hero graphic: the shoe has slid off its lime circle, which now sits clipped low-right as a stray blob. The NEW VIDEO badge sits awkwardly to the left of the logo on a different baseline, and the headline wraps to leave 'marathons' alone on its own line. B keeps the shoe inside its circle and puts logo and badge in a clean top row with a strong two-line headline, but the shoe circle is shrunk into the lower-left, 'Full review inside.' floats apart from everything, and the bottom third feels thin and empty.
